+## Native head の prefill lease
+
+`STRATA_PHASE_HEAD_LEASE=1` は起動時に固定され、既定は OFF です。既存の
+phase-cache 条件と native head が必要です。chunk は 8192 のままです。

+
+ON では startup の Prefill 初期化を最初の GEN まで遅らせます。Verifier
+初期化は head がロードされた状態で行い、head の kernel graph はまだ記録しません。
+各 GEN で checked quiescence、全 reader graph の破棄、head weights と scratch
+の解放、Prefill 初期化と run、成功後の Prefill reset の順に進みます。
+その後、同じ GGUF の元の型、形状、payload サイズ、shard、offset を再確認し、
+同じ upload と既存の row conversion を行ってから cache の公開と decode に進みます。
+Verifier は同じ NativeHead オブジェクトを参照し、新しい graph は再ロード後に記録します。
+GGUF の内容の同一性は呼び出し元の固定されたモデル契約が保証します。

+## Native head prefill lease
+
+`STRATA_PHASE_HEAD_LEASE=1` is frozen at startup and defaults to OFF. It requires
+the existing phase-cache admission and a native head. The chunk stays 8192.
+MTP, multiple GPUs, reuse and the short-read verifier path are excluded.
+
+ON defers startup Prefill initialization until the first GEN. Verifier initializes
+with a loaded head and does not yet record a head kernel graph. Each GEN checks
+quiescence, retires all reader graphs, releases head weights and scratch, initializes
+and runs Prefill, then resets Prefill after success. Only then does it revalidate
+the original GGUF type, shape, payload size, shard and offset, repeat the same
+upload and existing row conversion, and proceed to cache publication and decode.
+Verifier retains the same NativeHead object; new graphs record after reload.
+The caller's pinned model contract guarantees GGUF content identity. There is no
+large per-GEN file hash or retained RAM tensor.
+
+Head quiescence, release, upload and conversion enter prompt_ms. Failure, cancel,
+nonfinite or unknown completion fails closed; reload and retry are never recovery.
+QUIT exits after checked drain and graph retirement. Logs record original GGML
+and converted types, weights/scratch bytes, dimensions and actual free before
+and after release. Requested-byte arithmetic proves neither physical savings
+nor 12K/16K fit. CPU lifetime fixtures also cannot prove GPU completion.
